Task Guide:


Task: Magnesium NPT Equilibration for melting
Description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible nvt equilibrated Magnesium structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, relax the system under NPT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure file and the final density in gm/cm^3.

Required submission format:
{"density": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"density": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/structure.dat"}


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- Input from magnesium_potential_file_subtask_melting: /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/magnesium_potential_file_subtask_melting_trial_3/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy
- Input from magnesium_nvt_subtask_melting: {"density": "1.800", "path to relaxed structure": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/magnesium_nvt_subtask_melting_trial_3/equilibrated_structure.data"}
- units: metal
- pbc: true
- timestep: 1 femtosecond
- npt relaxation steps: 10000
- npt relaxation temperature: 300
- npt relaxation pressure: 0
- npt relaxation thermostat: Nose-Hoover
- npt relaxation barostat: Nose-Hoover
- atom_style: atomic

IMPORTANT: You have access to filesystem tools. All files will be saved in your isolated workspace.
 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/magnesium_npt_subtask_melting_trial_3 when using tools use this path.


This task uses output from tasks: magnesium_potential_file_subtask_melting (available), magnesium_nvt_subtask_melting (available)

You must think what to do next. You can use some of the tools available in the system.

When you think that the task is completed, you can submit the answer.
For that, answer with: "Final Answer: <your answer>". It is very important to follow this format.
